_comment: Per-league rules, hand-edited (never touched by the pipeline) and read by scripts/update_data.py and scripts/validate_data.py. "_default" applies to every league; list a league id below only to override the values that differ for it. A league not listed at all just uses "_default". weeks = weeks in the league, final_week = the week wins are worth final_win_points (that week onward), matches_per_week = expected matches in a full week (3 teams round-robin, 3 rounds = 9).
